speaker: alse_pinder
text: You are in. I heard the door. I am on the stair because the hall fire is banked and the basin is done, and I am not making a third reason. There is bread if you want it. I am not bringing it up unless you say.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not want it. The pages are on the desk. The letter is the flat one. Leave that one where it is.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can see which is flat and which is a fold, sir. I cannot read either, and I am not going to try by candle to become a person who can. The sheet is not in my hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Both turnings is far enough if that is as far as you have come. I am not sending you down and up again for bread.
